"""Full subprocess end-to-end run with a rich campaign and shape validation."""
import json, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/deps'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
import base64, io, plistlib, random, struct
import ipaddress, zstandard as zstd
from common import COLUMNS
from gen_targets import plan as plan_targets
from test_shape import check_shape

def adb(conn_banner=b'host::zgrab2', arg0=0x01000000, arg1=4096, command=0x4e584e43):
    return struct.pack('<6I', command, arg0, arg1, len(conn_banner),
                       sum(conn_banner) & 0xffffffff, command ^ 0xffffffff) + conn_banner

def sync(v1='17.4', v2='iPhone'):
    out = b''
    for key, value in (('ProductVersion', v1), ('ProductName', v2)):
        body = plistlib.dumps({'Key': key, 'Request': 'GetValue', 'Value': value})
        out += struct.pack('>I', len(body)) + body
    return out

def build():
    rnd = random.Random(4)
    leases = [
        {'id': 'alpha', 'prefix': '2001:db8:10::/56', 'start': 0, 'end': 500,
         'subnets': [0, 3], 'low_count': 3},
        {'id': 'beta', 'prefix': '2001:db8:20:40::/64', 'start': 100, 'end': 10**12 + 1,
         'subnets': [0], 'low_count': 2},
        {'id': 'gamma', 'prefix': '2001:db8:30::/56', 'start': 900, 'end': 1000,
         'subnets': [1], 'low_count': 2},
    ]
    services = [{'id': 'adb1', 'kind': 'adb'}, {'id': 'sync1', 'kind': 'sync'},
                {'id': 'web', 'kind': 'tcp'}]
    queries = [50, 400, 1500]
    ctx = {l['id']: {**l, 'network': ipaddress.IPv6Network(l['prefix']), 'subnets': l['subnets']}
           for l in leases}
    manifest, lookup, lows = plan_targets(ctx, 'camp')
    T = {k: str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(v[0])) for k, v in lookup.items()}
    rows1 = [
        # alpha: internal discovery on two subnets, one external, one canary hit
        ['icmp', 'a1', '0', '10', 'put', 'alpha', '5', '0/i1', T[('alpha', '0/i1')], T[('alpha', '0/i1')], 'echo', '', '', ''],
        ['icmp', 'a2', '0', '10', 'put', 'alpha', '6', '0/i2', T[('alpha', '0/i2')], T[('alpha', '0/i2')], 'echo', '', '', ''],
        ['icmp', 'a3', '0', '10', 'put', 'alpha', '7', '3/i1', T[('alpha', '3/i1')], '2001:db8:10:3::dead', 'echo', '', '', ''],
        ['icmp', 'a4', '0', '10', 'put', 'alpha', '8', '0/i3', T[('alpha', '0/i3')], '', 'timeout', '', '', ''],
        ['icmp', 'a5', '0', '10', 'put', 'alpha', '9', '0/c', T[('alpha', '0/c')], '2001:db8:10::1', 'error', '', '', ''],
        # beta: canary self echo -> alias quarantine
        ['icmp', 'b1', '0', '120', 'put', 'beta', '110', '0/c', T[('beta', '0/c')], T[('beta', '0/c')], 'echo', '', '', ''],
        ['icmp', 'b2', '0', '120', 'put', 'beta', '111', '0/i1', T[('beta', '0/i1')], T[('beta', '0/i1')], 'echo', '', '', ''],
        # application evidence
        ['app', 'p1', '0', '20', 'put', 'alpha', '10', '', T[('alpha', '0/i1')], '', 'open', 'adb1', '0', base64.b64encode(adb()).decode()],
        ['app', 'p2', '0', '20', 'put', 'alpha', '10', '', T[('alpha', '0/i1')], '', 'open', 'adb1', '1', base64.b64encode(adb()).decode()],
        ['app', 'p3', '0', '20', 'put', 'alpha', '11', '', T[('alpha', '0/i2')], '', 'open', 'sync1', '0', base64.b64encode(sync()).decode()],
        ['app', 'p4', '0', '20', 'put', 'alpha', '11', '', '2001:db8:10:3::dead', '', 'closed', 'web', '0', ''],

        ['app', 'p6', '0', '20', 'put', 'beta', '120', '', T[('beta', '0/i1')], '', 'open', 'web', '0', ''],

        ['icmp', 'gone', '0', '32', 'put', 'alpha', '12', '0/i3', T[('alpha', '0/i3')], T[('alpha', '0/i3')], 'echo', '', '', ''],
        ['icmp', 'gone', '1', '33', 'delete', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', ''],
        # rejected rows
        ['icmp', 'bad1', '0', '34', 'put', 'alpha', '12', '9/i9', T[('alpha', '0/i1')], T[('alpha', '0/i1')], 'echo', '', '', ''],
        ['app', 'bad2', '0', '35', 'put', 'alpha', '12', '', T[('alpha', '0/i1')], '', 'open', 'web', '0', base64.b64encode(b'x').decode()],
    ]
    rows2 = [
        # later publication changes alpha state at query 400
        ['icmp', 'a9', '0', '300', 'put', 'alpha', '200', '0/i1', T[('alpha', '0/i1')], '2001:db8:10::1', 'echo', '', '', ''],
        ['icmp', 'g1', '0', '950', 'put', 'gamma', '910', '1/i1', T[('gamma', '1/i1')], T[('gamma', '1/i1')], 'echo', '', '', ''],
        ['icmp', 'g2', '0', '950', 'put', 'gamma', '911', '1/i2', T[('gamma', '1/i2')], T[('gamma', '1/i1')], 'echo', '', '', ''],
    ]
    def cap(rows, encoding, splits=1):
        text = ','.join(COLUMNS) + '\n' + ''.join(','.join(r) + '\n' for r in rows)
        data = text.encode()
        if encoding == 'zstd':
            data = zstd.ZstdCompressor().compress(data)
        size = max(1, -(-len(data) // splits))
        return {'encoding': encoding,
                'chunks': [base64.b64encode(data[i:i + size]).decode()
                           for i in range(0, len(data), size)] or ['']}
    requests = [
        {'id': 'req1', 'at': 50, 'lease': 'alpha', 'target': T[('alpha', '0/i1')], 'service': 'web', 'group': 'g1'},
        {'id': 'req2', 'at': 50, 'lease': 'alpha', 'target': T[('alpha', '0/i2')], 'service': 'adb1', 'group': 'g2'},

        {'id': 'off3', 'time': 420, 'service': 'sync1', 'prefix': '2001:db8::/32', 'capacity': 1,
         'cost': 9, 'group': 'h2', 'requests': ['req3']},
        {'id': 'off4', 'time': 1600, 'service': 'web', 'prefix': '2001:db8:30::/56', 'capacity': 5,
         'cost': 1, 'group': 'h2', 'requests': ['req4', 'req5']},
        {'id': 'off5', 'time': 10, 'service': 'web', 'prefix': '2001:db8::/32', 'capacity': 5,
         'cost': 0, 'group': 'h1', 'requests': ['req1']},
    ]
    return {'version': 3, 'seed': 'camp', 'leases': leases, 'services': services,
            'queries': queries, 'captures': [cap(rows1, 'csv', 3), cap(rows2, 'zstd', 2)],
            'requests': requests, 'offers': offers,
            'request_quotas': [{'id': 'g0', 'parent': None, 'capacity': 3},
                               {'id': 'g1', 'parent': 'g0', 'capacity': 2},
                               {'id': 'g2', 'parent': 'g0', 'capacity': 2}],
            'offer_quotas': [{'id': 'h0', 'parent': None, 'capacity': 4},
                             {'id': 'h1', 'parent': 'h0', 'capacity': 2},
                             {'id': 'h2', 'parent': 'h0', 'capacity': 2}]}

def main():
    job = build()
    raw = json.dumps(job).encode()
    work = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir='/workspace/tmp')
    env = dict(os.environ, TMPDIR=work, PYTHONHASHSEED='0')
    proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '/workspace/submission/campaign.py'],
                          input=raw, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                          cwd=work, env=env)
    assert proc.returncode == 0, proc.stderr.decode()
    res = json.loads(proc.stdout)
    check_shape(job, res)
    print('rejected:', res['rejected'])
    print('ledgers:', [s['ledger'] for s in res['snapshots']])
    print('unbound:', [s['unbound_applications'] for s in res['snapshots']])
    for index, snap in enumerate(res['snapshots']):
        for report in snap['leases']:
            print(index, report['lease'], report['state'],
                  [(s['id'], s['internal_open'], s['internal_closed'], s['external_open'],
                    s['external_closed'], s['internal_only'], s['protocol_errors'])
                   for s in report['services']])
    print('active:', res['active_requests'])
    print('plan:', res['plan']['resolved'], res['plan']['cost'],
          [(a['request'], a['offer']) for a in res['plan']['assignments']])
    print('stderr:', proc.stderr.decode()[:400])

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
